name: Universal Technologies Holdings Limited
summary: Universal Technologies Holdings Limited is an investment holding firm that has operated from Sheung Wan, Hong Kong since 2001. Its main business is water supply and related services in China and beyond, including drinking water distribution in Qingyuan City, Guangdong. It also develops, leases and manages land and buildings, offers corporate finance advice, asset oversight, securities trading and margin loans, and provides investment advisory and water quality assessment.
